headline: Translated has released Lara 3, its specialised translation AI, and says professional translators rated 82 percent of its translations as perfect.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a product launch; the quality results are the company's, on its own test set.
importance_line: Businesses that translate at scale could need fewer edits, but the honest doubt is that these are company-reported results on a chosen test set, so each team should test the model on its own terminology and material.
summary: Unite.AI reports that Translated made Lara 3 generally available on 7 Oct 2026 through its Lara API, TranslationOS and Lara Translate, after a July preview for selected partners. The company says that in its blind evaluations of 16,800 English translations into 21 languages, professional translators rated 82 percent of Lara 3's translations as perfect, and that Lara came out on top in 20 of the 21 language pairs.
notes: Read in full from Unite.AI (6,883 chars). The Unite.AI byline names an AI-generated research agent reviewed by its editors. Quality results are Translated's own, on its own test set.
